evidence: Matches the P2P label and directly modifies P2P compact block processing and nonce generation across network interfaces.
rationale: Fixes a privacy leak where an attacker can trivially link a node's clearnet IP and Tor identities by comparing compact block nonces. The PR description notes that 'anyone can request the most recent tip as a compact block via getdata(MSG_CMPCT_BLOCK) over a clearnet and a tor connection and then compare the nonces - if they match it's the same node', breaking identity separation across networks.
